cues.en: Arriving at APL this past summer to participate in an on-site field study with the modular prosthetic limb, MPL,
cues.zh: 今年夏天来到 APL，参与模块化假肢 MPL 的现场实测时，

cues.en: Les Bauh and his girlfriend were excited about the possibilities.
cues.zh: Les Baugh 和他的女友对未来的可能性充满期待。

cues.en: Accompanying them is Doctor. Albert Chi, who as part of the interdisciplinary
cues.zh: 陪同他们的是 Albert Chi 医生，作为来自

cues.en: team from the Johns Hopkins Hospital performed the targeted re innovation surgery necessary for today's visit.
cues.zh: 约翰斯·霍普金斯医院跨学科团队的一员，他主刀了这次实测所需的“目标神经再分布”手术。

cues.en: I went into the surgery knowing that he was going to move nerves
cues.zh: 我做手术时就知道，他要把神经

cues.en: in my chest. I remember when I first come out from under it,
cues.zh: 转移到我的胸部。我记得刚做完手术清醒过来时，

cues.en: the pain I'd never had. I don't even remember the original being that much excruciating pain, but I imagine part my mind blocked out anyway. Les had lost both limbs in a freak electrical accident over forty years ago and is excited to become the first shoulder level amputee
cues.zh: 那种痛我这辈子都没体验过。我甚至不记得最初受伤时有这么剧痛，不过我想可能是大脑选择性遗忘了。四十多年前，Les 在一起离奇的触电事故中失去了双臂，如今他很兴奋能成为首位肩部离断受试者

cues.en: to have the MPL fully and wirelessly
cues.zh: 让 MPL 完全无线地

cues.en: integrated into his body. It started with really intensive training with our pattern recognition system.
cues.zh: 集成到他体内。一开始是用我们的模式识别系统进行高强度训练。

cues.en: And what the pattern recognition system is a
cues.zh: 所谓的模式识别系统，其实是一个

cues.en: advanced algorithm that really looks at high density electrode arrays on the
cues.zh: 先进算法，它会读取我们重新支配的

cues.en: chest muscles, we've reinnervated,
cues.zh: 胸部肌肉上高密度电极阵列的数据，

cues.en: that looks at the almost signature symphony of muscle activity information,
cues.zh: 读取那几乎像签名一样独特的肌肉活动信息交响，

cues.en: and we take that information and translate that to actual movements within a prosthetic. Let's go ahead and see what we have. On this day, Les is being fitted for his socket, which is sort of a body brace that makes the neural connections with the reinnervated nerves as well as supports the prosthetic limbs. The first cast they did on me for the test socket was all done with electronics.
cues.zh: 然后我们把信息转化为假肢的实际动作。我们来看看效果如何。这一天，Les 正在配适他的接受腔，这是一种身体支架，既能让神经与重新支配的神经建立连接，也能支撑假肢。他们为我做测试接受腔时的第一次取模，全程都是用电子方式完成的。

cues.en: They took like a,
cues.zh: 他们拿着一个，

cues.en: I don't know, like a scanner
cues.zh: 我也不知道，像是个扫描仪

cues.en: and just started walking around my body and they just painted it on the screen and boom they sent it off and I get out here and it fits.
cues.zh: 然后就开始围着我的身体扫描，把它绘制到屏幕上，接着一下子就把数据发走了。我出来之后，义肢正合适。

cues.en: This guy says no. So I can't feel every little dimple and divot that I wanna feel. He said I wanna do it with plaster. Great. And this old school is working out so much better than the modern.
cues.zh: 这家伙说不行。所以我没法摸清每一处我想感受的小凹痕和凹陷。他说他想用石膏来做。好啊。结果这套老办法比现代方法好用多了。

cues.en: While the socket got its finishing touches, the team took the next step and had Les work with the virtual reality system that mimics the actual prosthetic arms. Relax.
cues.zh: 接受腔做最后的修整时，团队开始了下一步：让莱斯使用虚拟现实系统，模拟真实的义肢手臂。放松。

cues.en: Let's do some elbow, elbow up.
cues.zh: 动一下肘部，肘部抬起。

cues.en: Good. Relax.
cues.zh: 很好。放松。

cues.en: A couple days later, the socket was back and the arms were attached.
cues.zh: 几天后，接受腔做好了，假肢也安装完毕。

cues.en: Les and the team were about to make history.
cues.zh: Les 和整个团队即将创造历史。

cues.en: Once
cues.zh: 一旦

cues.en: the training sessions were complete and they released me and let me be the computer,
cues.zh: 训练全部结束，他们放手让我来充当这台计算机，

cues.en: basically,
cues.zh: 基本上，

cues.en: to control that arm,
cues.zh: 来控制那条手臂时，

cues.en: I just go into a whole different world.
cues.zh: 我整个人就仿佛进入了另一个全新的世界。

cues.en: I think we're just getting started at this point. It's like the early days of the Internet. There's just a tremendous amount of potential ahead of us and and we've just started down this road. I think the next
cues.zh: 我觉得我们现在才刚刚起步。这就像互联网的早期时代。摆在我们面前的是巨大的潜力，而我们才刚刚迈出第一步。我认为接下来的

cues.en: five, ten years are gonna bring some really phenomenal advancements.
cues.zh: 五到十年里，将会迎来一些真正令人惊叹的突破。

cues.en: Other milestones reached by the team were, this was the first time the MPLs were operated by a shoulder level amputee
cues.zh: 团队达成的其他里程碑包括：这是首次由肩部截肢者操作MPL

cues.en: at the full three degrees of freedom and with over 30 total degrees of motion on both sides
cues.zh: 实现完整的三自由度，两侧总运动自由度超过30个

cues.en: with complete intuitive thought based control.
cues.zh: 并且完全基于直觉思维控制。

cues.en: He has access to all of the different degrees of motion shoulder, elbow,
cues.zh: 他可以使用肩、肘、

cues.en: wrist, hand but he still needs
cues.zh: 腕、手的各种运动自由度，但他仍然需要

cues.en: which one he wants to use. So he needs to position the shoulder, then the elbow, then the wrist, then the hand separately and rest in between.
cues.zh: 选择要用哪一个。所以他需要先定位肩部，然后肘部，然后腕部，最后单独定位手部，中间还要休息。

cues.en: Maybe I'll be able to, for once, be able to put change in a pop machine and get the pop out of it. Simple things like that that most people never think of,
cues.zh: 也许有一天，我终于能把硬币投进自动售货机，然后买到汽水。就是这种简单的小事，大多数人从来不会想到，

cues.en: And it's re available to me. What
cues.zh: 而它又能供我使用。我们

cues.en: we'd really like to be able to do is send him home with a couple of limbs
cues.zh: 真正希望做到的，是让他带着几条仿生肢体回家，

cues.en: so that, you know, he can use them in his everyday life. And what this has showed us is that that's really possible.
cues.zh: 这样你知道，他就能在日常生活中使用它们。这让我们看到，这确实是可能的。

cues.en: All of us on this RP twenty nineteen, regardless of the type of patient we're fitting, are committed to making every effort to see that this ultimately reaches
cues.zh: 我们 RP 二〇一九项目的所有人，无论为哪类患者安装设备，都致力于尽一切努力，确保最终能让

cues.en: the end user in a way that they can actually utilize it. That's awesome.
cues.zh: 终端用户真正用上它。太棒了。

cues.en: It's not just the accomplishment, but the opening of frontiers and realizing
cues.zh: 这不仅是一项成就，更是新领域的开拓，并让我们意识到

cues.en: that there's so much more to learn. This unique opportunity of interfacing with the end user, utilizing our technology, provides valuable feedback to the team.
cues.zh: 还有太多东西需要去探索。这次与最终用户面对面、让他们使用我们技术的绝佳机会，为团队提供了宝贵的反馈。

cues.en: Feedback that will assist this DARPA developed technology in helping wounded warriors and others to regain the 27 degrees of freedom possessed by the human arm.
cues.zh: 这些反馈将助力这项由 DARPA 开发的技术，帮助伤残军人和其他人重获人类手臂所拥有的 27 个自由度。
